propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix runs on stale Gerrit patchsets omitting commit 96a0d5c3f enter the default suite, reach 99% progress, then hang for 1.7–4.3 hours without timeout until manual cancellation; the mechanism is per-blob lazy-fetch on blobless partial clones during git checkout-index.

The _build-and-test.yml reusable workflow test job lacks timeout-minutes configuration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit; adding a 60-minute bound prevents manual-clear dependence while preserving a >3x safety margin over observed 10–16 minute normal execution.

Gerrit 1129 contains a test (test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract) whose FakeJiraClient.search_issues did not respect startAt/maxResults pagination kwargs, causing an infinite loop when the production pager advanced offsets; adding offset-based slicing to the fake fixes the timeout.

Manual cancellation of stuck matrix jobs blocks subsequent runs in the queue; a repository-level timeout bound eliminates this secondary blocking and makes CI resilient to recurrence of the lazy-fetch or pagination defects.
The 747f per-blob lazy-fetch defect and the 1129 pagination infinite-loop are root causes; the workflow timeout is a containment fix that bounds symptom scope and eliminates manual intervention.
